status: authored construction map; final artwork review follows steps 1–5
coordinates: Reference pixels, origin top left; x right, y down.
meaning: Projected bundle territories and visible flow only. No physical surface, depth, strand topology or personal data is inferred. Overlapping territories are intentional and do not establish depth order.

constructionRules.allowedMaterial: Inside S1, excluding enclosed openings. Exterior-connected void markers identify background cores; S1 owns their full edges.
constructionRules.allowedBundle: Intersection of a bundle territory with allowedMaterial. Raw territory paths may overlap or extend beyond S1; never generate directly in their unclipped area.
constructionRules.uncertainRecesses: U1 and U2 remain material candidates, not established holes. Review their depth before generating threads there.
constructionRules.unassignedMaterial: U3: envelope material outside all six bundle territories. This boundary/transition reserve is explicit uncertainty, not permission to add threads. Assign it to an authored route in step 2 before use.
constructionRules.overlap: Territory draw order is only diagram presentation. It is not physical front-to-back order.
constructionRules.flowArrows: Reading direction for visible routes, not actual movement or a required direction for individual threads. Hidden continuations are unauthored.
